preparation.limits: Preparation includes fixture construction, validation, original/derived writes, hashes, and a preview verification per clip. It is not an ASR or ingestion-only speed measurement.

runs.latency_quantiles: median averages the center pair; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n); max includes every sample
runs.scope: Synthetic long timed transcripts, keyword retrieval, same raw text/ranking in full and preview modes. No model inference/capture/network. Each trial retains the previous result list while loading the next, like UI publication. Query peak is measured before response encoding/hydration. OS/file caches are uncontrolled; separate fresh processes are not controlled cold-cache trials. No energy or competitor claim.

checks: Identical ordered source IDs across full/preview trials
Every returned source retains complete original text
Full results retain all timed segments; previews explicitly omit them and report counts/revision
Opening one selected result revalidates and returns every timed segment
limits: Synthetic repeated token transcripts; unscoped keyword query only, not natural relevance or model quality
Same binary/archive, alternating order, separate process peaks; caches/background OS activity uncontrolled
Query peak is sampled before response encoding/one-source hydration; all stages reported separately
Raw text remains in previews; this optimizes timed transcript payloads, not arbitrary source length
No capture, power, natural-meeting, competitor or general all-query performance claim
source_state: Search-preview worktree on this base; exact relevant source-file and release-binary hashes retained
